Guess the PSA 10 price of all 3 cheap Pokémon cards, then swipe for the answers. How close were you? 👇

Answers (no peeking 🙈):
#1 Pidgeotto 208/197 (Obsidian Flames): $8.25 raw → $199 PSA 10 (24×)
#2 Ho-Oh V 187/195 (Silver Tempest): $8.49 raw → $199 PSA 10 (23×)
#3 Slakoth 212/191 (Surging Sparks): $10.79 raw → $210 PSA 10 (19×)

PSA 10 = median eBay sold price over the last 30 days. Raw = TCGplayer market price. Not every card grades a 10, so check centering first (free centering tool at market.driveyourstyle.net).
